body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News & Press Release> Toshiba presented ‘SD-P91S’, its portable DVD player during CES 2008, which adopted 9-inch widescreen LCD swivel screen and dual headphone outputs, and supports WMA, MP3 and JPEG playback.
Like ‘SD-P101S’, this portable model offers approximately five hours of battery life, a car cord adapter and is DivX Home Theater Certified. It is available for 179.99(USD) in February 2008.
< AVING Special Report Team for ‘CES 2008’: Publisher and Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Rose Kim, Alliyah Seo, Joshua Shim, Li Coffee, Brain Park >
